messages.content: The Dallas meetings are at the Renaissance Dallas Hotel on Stemmons Freeway. Their block is gone. Compare the Hilton Anatole and the Marriott Suites Medical/Market Center for Tuesday and Wednesday nights, then tell me whether a car makes any financial sense.

I’ll price November 4-6 for one adult and include taxes, hotel parking, the DFW trip, and transportation to the Renaissance. Are you checking a bag, and do you expect to go anywhere besides the meeting hotel and your own hotel?
No checked bag. Dinner Tuesday is at the Renaissance too. Wednesday is entirely there. Thursday I’ll go straight to DFW after the morning session, probably around 12:15.

The Hilton Anatole is the easier location. A refundable king is $229 per night, or $535.86 with tax for two nights. It is about 0.7 mile from the Renaissance: roughly 4-7 minutes by car, though the entrances and freeway frontage make walking less practical than the map suggests. Self-parking is $32 nightly.

The Marriott Suites is $189 per night refundable, totaling $442.26 with tax. It is about 2.5 miles away, generally 7-12 minutes by car in meeting-hour traffic. Self-parking is $15 nightly. Both rates can be cancelled without charge until 11:59 p.m. local time on November 2.
Put actual transportation totals against those. Include the airport both ways.

With rides, I would budget $55 from DFW to either hotel Tuesday, $14 each way between the Anatole and Renaissance, or $18 each way from the Marriott Suites, plus $50 from the hotel area to DFW Thursday. That produces these stay-and-ground totals:

Hilton Anatole: $535.86 room + $55 airport ride + $56 for four short rides + $50 return to DFW = $696.86.

Marriott Suites: $442.26 room + $55 airport ride + $72 for four local rides + $50 return to DFW = $619.26.

The ride figures include a modest traffic allowance but not tips.
And the rental? Don’t leave out DFW fees or parking at the meeting hotel if that applies.

A midsize rental is $171.40 all-in for Tuesday morning through Thursday around 1:00 p.m. Add about $18 for fuel. The Renaissance charges $24 per day for visitor self-parking; assuming Tuesday afternoon and Wednesday, that is $48.

At the Anatole, add $64 for two hotel nights, bringing the rental version to $837.26. At the Marriott Suites, add $30 for two nights, bringing it to $709.66. The rental is therefore about $140 more than rides at the Anatole and $90 more at the Marriott, with no useful time advantage for this schedule.
So Marriott with rides is the sensible one. Is it still a suite, and what’s the exact cancellation rule and payment timing?

Yes. The available room is a one-bedroom suite with one king bed and a separate living area. The total is $442.26: $378.00 room charges and $64.26 estimated taxes. A card guarantees the reservation, but no deposit is charged now; the hotel collects payment at checkout. Cancellation is free through 11:59 p.m. Central Time on Sunday, November 2. Cancelling after that carries a one-night room-and-tax charge of $221.13.
Book that. Use the same card from the Dallas flight. No rental.

Before I complete it: one guest, November 4 check-in and November 6 check-out, king one-bedroom suite at the Dallas Marriott Suites Medical/Market Center, $442.26 total, card guarantee only, and rides throughout. Correct?
Correct. Also make sure the late-morning arrival won’t be treated as a no-show if the room isn’t ready.

It will not. I’ll list an expected arrival around 11:30 a.m.; check-in begins at 4:00 p.m., so early access is only a request, but the hotel can hold your bag. The reservation remains active for the night even if the room is not ready when you arrive.

Booked at the Dallas Marriott Suites Medical/Market Center under confirmation DMS-581407. The stay is November 4-6 for one king one-bedroom suite, totaling $442.26 including estimated taxes. No deposit was charged; the card guarantees the room and payment is due at the hotel. Cancellation is free through 11:59 p.m. Central Time on November 2, then one night plus tax, $221.13.

No rental car was reserved. After American flight J4V8NC lands at DFW at 9:50 a.m. Tuesday, use a ride to the hotel; with no checked bag, arrival should be about 11:05-11:30 a.m. depending on terminal pickup and traffic. Early check-in is requested, and the hotel will hold luggage if needed. Budget $177 for airport and meeting rides, putting Dallas flights, lodging, and expected ground transportation at $1,037.26 before tips.
